scope: Fourteen detailed controls candidates, plus named search/screening exclusions; official GitHub metadata, default-branch files, release redirects and publisher documentation. Broad targeted research, not all GitHub, code audit or deployment qualification.

screened_extras.decision: Defer replacing Ariadne orchestration: substantial existing-engine overlap; evidence https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/releases/tag/1.2.18
Library underpinning preferred server; not itself an automatically certified Matter product; evidence https://github.com/matter-js/matter.js/blob/main/README.md
Discovery-only small wrapper; no authority or security qualification performed.

limits: No repository code was cloned, executed or installed.
No hardware, camera, microphone, accounts, network settings or services were changed.
No whole-dependency vulnerability/license audit, benchmark, hardware commissioning or offline cold-start was performed.
Default-branch documentation can be ahead of releases; every integration needs exact artifact/license/dependency pins and independent qualification.
Rankings and operating-cost implications are architectural judgments; no numerical energy or monetary savings were measured.

candidates.name: Home Assistant Core
candidates.best_use: Local device state and reviewed automation
candidates.offline: Local integrations can work offline; cloud integrations do not. VM/container and local network/devices remain powered.
candidates.existing_overlap: Existing fixed Node-RED and MCP supply a transport but no physical-device inventory.
candidates.adapter: Start with a localhost read gateway for selected entity IDs, timestamps and unavailable states; later exact service/parameters approval.
candidates.operating_cost: Separate VM/container, recorder retention, backups and integration updates; no added language model required.
risks: Every authenticated HA user is an owner-like trust boundary under current security policy.
MCP defaults expose all LLM APIs; select APIs/entities instead of importing broad authority.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: ESPHome
candidates.best_use: Purpose-built local sensors and low-risk device endpoints
candidates.license: MIT for Python/other code; GPL-3.0 for C++ runtime
candidates.offline: Flashed firmware communicates locally; offline rebuild also needs the cached toolchain and exact component sources.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne has no commissioned ESP hardware adapter; reuse HA gateway rather than second device authority path.
candidates.adapter: Prototype temperature, environment or power telemetry via encrypted native API; device-specific bounded commands only after simulation.
candidates.operating_cost: Requires suitable microcontroller/sensors, firmware/toolchain archive and firmware updates; device hardware draws power.
risks: Native API encryption must be configured, not inferred.
External components/lambdas compile code; unreviewed YAML is not harmless configuration.
Physical installation and actuation need their own engineering review.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Eclipse Mosquitto
candidates.best_use: Local MQTT event bus and bounded device telemetry
candidates.offline: Native Windows packages are available; local broker/client traffic needs no WAN after provisioning.
candidates.existing_overlap: Existing Node-RED can consume MQTT; Ariadne currently exposes only fixed HTTP routes, so arbitrary flows are not already approved.
candidates.adapter: Gateway subscribes to selected state topics; write topics have separate credentials/ACLs and expiring exact command IDs.
candidates.operating_cost: One small local broker service plus bounded retained/persistent storage; no inference required for routing.
risks: Local-only anonymous defaults are for tests; authenticated listeners and topic ACLs are needed for a connected system.
Retained messages and redelivery can repeat unsafe commands unless command expiry/idempotency is implemented.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Open Home Foundation Matter.js Server
candidates.best_use: Current Matter controller behind Home Assistant
candidates.offline: Local commissioned-device control is useful offline; Thread/BLE/IPv6/mDNS and commissioning trust data still need qualification.
candidates.existing_overlap: Prefer HA integration instead of adding a second device/fabric authority store to Ariadne.
candidates.adapter: Use current HA-supported Matter server and read selected attributes via the HA gateway; preserve fabric/storage backup.
candidates.operating_cost: Node.js server and supported radio/border-router/network setup; extra credential-bearing state and upgrade/migration burden.
risks: README supports Node 22.13+,24.x or26.x; not a claim of a native Windows hardware qualification.
The new server can migrate Python-server state on first start; do not try migration against owner devices during research.
matter.js library itself does not certify a product.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Legacy Python Matter Server
candidates.offline: Legacy local controller; not a new offline foundation.
candidates.existing_overlap: Do not add this archived server to Ariadne.
candidates.adapter: Use its documentation only when planning a separately reviewed migration to matterjs-server.
candidates.operating_cost: Unsupported legacy maintenance would add avoidable burden.
risks: Repository archived June23,2026.
README identifies8.1.2 as final and says updates/support have ended.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Zigbee2MQTT
candidates.best_use: Local Zigbee devices and sensor state
candidates.offline: Works with local MQTT broker; Windows supported with Node and an appropriate coordinator/driver; no mandatory cloud for local devices.
candidates.existing_overlap: Adds radio-backed device support; reuse MQTT/HA gateway and existing approval records.
candidates.adapter: Start with coordinator simulator and read telemetry; later specific allowed device commands with reconciliation.
candidates.operating_cost: Separate Node process, adapter firmware/device compatibility and key/coordinator backups.
risks: Needs supported coordinator and actual compatible devices; none were discovered or commissioned.
Do not accept unexpected onboarding/port8080 conflicts with Ariadne.
RF interference and coordinator failure are distinct from AI reliability.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: pywinauto
candidates.offline: Can operate local Windows apps offline; many keyboard/mouse operations require an active desktop.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne has loopback browser automation but no general approved native desktop controller.
candidates.adapter: One app/process-identity allowlist, semantic UI selectors, short session lease, before/after evidence and explicit write approvals.
candidates.operating_cost: On-demand Python worker; no new model required for deterministic app tasks; UI changes create maintenance.
risks: Docs label0.6.8 while GitHub latesttag is0.6.9; exact bundled Python3.13 compatibility remains unqualified.
Lock/RDP/session changes can break desktop interaction.
Never route trading orders or privileged OS changes through a generic click/type tool.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: FlaUI
candidates.offline: Native Win32/WinForms/WPF inspection and interaction can run locally; .NET/runtime assets must be cached.
candidates.existing_overlap: Alternative to pywinauto, not a reason to bundle both.
candidates.adapter: Compare one problematic target app against pywinauto; fixed signed worker and selected automation IDs.
candidates.operating_cost: Adds .NET worker/build/runtime footprint and UI regression maintenance; choose only on measured app compatibility.
risks: UIA2/UIA3 behavior varies by target framework.
Release5 removes older .NET targets and adds .NET8; this PC's target-app/session compatibility is not measured.
Desktop UI access itself is broad authority; library license does not constrain it.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Playwright
candidates.best_use: Operate and verify local business web applications
candidates.offline: Existing local runtime works with provisioned browser assets; live websites still require network/account access.
candidates.existing_overlap: Already integrated for approved loopback apps; extend fixed workflows rather than adding an unrestricted MCP browser.
candidates.adapter: Read inventory screens, fill draft local forms, verify generated apps and save bounded evidence; approvals remain per write.
candidates.operating_cost: On-demand browser and regression tests; cache exact matching browser revision; no additional AI service by itself.
risks: Browser contexts and request routing are not an OS sandbox.
Existing Ariadne local origin/path confinement must remain; do not expose generic navigation to owner sessions.
Publisher's token-efficiency marketing is not a local measurement.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Microsoft DSC
candidates.best_use: Declarative system inventory and approved configuration plans
candidates.offline: Cross-platform standalone CLI; fixed resources can operate offline after provisioning.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne has independent hosting but no general checked OS desired-state inventory.
candidates.adapter: Begin with reviewed resource Get/Test only and produce a drift report; Set is a separate exact configuration approval.
candidates.operating_cost: On-demand command rather than a new scheduler/service; resource manifests and binaries need pinned updates.
risks: Get/Test labels do not make an arbitrary third-party resource trustworthy.
Set can change OS/software/services outside Yikes; current research grants no such exception.
Resource code may spawn programs or contact networks; review each fixed resource implementation.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: OpenHands Agent Canvas
candidates.license: MIT for inspected core repository; editions/providers/dependencies separate
candidates.offline: Local backend is possible; offline operation also needs local model, dependency/container caches and a blocked network test.
candidates.existing_overlap: Substantial overlap with Ariadne agents, schedules, files, reviews and independent host; avoid second default control plane.
candidates.adapter: Use only a disposable project snapshot and qualified sandbox for coding benchmark; review patches before applying.
candidates.operating_cost: Extra agent backend/UI/sandbox lifecycle and model inference; Docker Desktop is not currently part of the verified box.
risks: Current default-branch README warns direct no-sandbox agent server has full filesystem access.
Docker recommended provider is not proof of sufficient mounts/egress/credential isolation.
Do not run repository instructions, self-updates or autonomous deployment as part of this scan.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Official MCP Python SDK
candidates.offline: SDK can serve local tools over standard transports; each actual tool controls offline behavior.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne already uses checksum-pinned FastMCP slim4.1.4 with explicit reviewed protocol modes; do not blindly replace its client.
candidates.adapter: Build narrow loopback-only business/device gateways, select tool identities and schemas, retain approved read/write policy.
candidates.operating_cost: Additional gateway dependency only where existing fixed HTTP is insufficient; protocol upgrades need compatibility tests.
risks: SDK examples and read-only annotations are not authorization.
Currentv2 APIs differ from oldexamples; keep Ariadne's pinned protocol contract until tested.
Do not enable sampling, resources, elicitation or arbitrary server registration by default.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: OpenTelemetry Collector
candidates.best_use: Local service metrics and traces across optional engines
candidates.offline: Collector can route telemetry locally; exporters and receivers must be explicitly configured.
candidates.existing_overlap: Existing receipts/logs cover single-box work; useful when multiple optional business/device services justify correlation.
candidates.adapter: Local receiver/exporter only, bounded queue/retention, redact prompt/document/credential payloads; chart task success and measured latency.
candidates.operating_cost: One optional daemon and telemetry storage; disable unused receivers/exporters and avoid high-cardinality traces.
risks: Examples include network listeners/exporters; do not assume a private default.
Observability may capture sensitive data and creates disk/CPU work.
No measured savings or native resource budget established.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.

candidates.name: Temporal
candidates.offline: Self-hosted service is possible; single-binary development mode is not a production recovery qualification.
candidates.existing_overlap: Current Ariadne already has durable mission/routine receipts and fail-stop uncertainty handling.
candidates.adapter: Consider only when a concrete multi-service workflow exceeds current engine; bind external action idempotency/reconciliation explicitly.
candidates.operating_cost: Extra production service/storage, workers, auth/TLS, schema upgrades, backups and monitoring.
risks: Workflow durability and retries do not establish exactly-once physical actions or trading orders.
candidates.release_date_note: Latest-page tag or official download version observed on checked_at_utc; exact machine-readable publication timestamp was not verified.
